semiconductor_relevance: High — SiliconAuto is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in automotive microcontrollers and SoCs for electric and autonomous vehicles.
summary: SiliconAuto Taiwan CO., LTD. designs and develops automotive-grade semiconductor solutions aimed at enhancing the capabilities of electric and autonomous vehicles. Founded in 2023, the company focuses on simplifying automotive electronics and accelerating the integration of advanced technologies into next-generation vehicles.

regional_presence.Taiwan: SiliconAuto is strategically positioned within Taiwan's advanced semiconductor ecosystem, collaborating with leading industry partners.
